about_the_game:
A multithreaded typing battle where players compete through speed and strategy.

Players control aggressive software, attacking each other by sending viruses designed to destroy their opponent.

On the board—laid out like a chessboard—virus-shaped pieces are placed. By moving these pieces and pushing them into the opponent’s side, players inflict damage. The first player whose health reaches zero is destroyed.

Players must manage actions such as “moving pieces,” “generating pieces,” and “activating skills” to fend off enemy assaults while launching their own.
Every action requires completing typing challenges.

By repeatedly typing short words, players can execute desired actions. Stronger actions require completing more typing tasks.

Typing speed alone is not enough—you must carefully consider when and which action to take, efficiently clearing challenges to outmaneuver your opponent.

The game will feature both a Story Mode, where players battle CPUs while uncovering their origins and mysteries, and an Online Versus Mode, where typists from around the world can face off.
